data.name: Jawaadah
data.gender_notes: Jawaadah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: جَوَادَة نام کے لیے دُرّ اور سخائے کے ساتھ ہے اور اسے اسلام میں پڑھائیں گیا ہے۔. The name Jawaadah carries the meaning “Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Jawaadah usually hope their child will grow to embody generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Being generous and liberal in every aspect of life.
data.etymology: Jawaadah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawaadah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جوادة
in_arabic.long_meaning: جوادة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر جواد، ويعني الجود والكرم وال سخاء، وله أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يُعتبر الجود والكرم من أهم الصفات التي يجب أن يتصف بها المسلم، وذكر في القرآن الكريم في سورة الذاريات

in_urdu.name: جوادہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: جوادہ عربی نام ہے جو جواد سے ماخوذ ہے، جو سخاوت اور کرم کے معنی رکھتا ہے، یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے، کیونکہ سخاوت اور کرم کو مسلمانوں کے لیے اہم صفات سمجھا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जवादह
in_hindi.meaning: दानशील और उदार महिला का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: जवादह एक अरबी नाम है जो जवाद से उत्पन्न हुआ है, जिसका अर्थ है दानशीलता और उदारता, यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है, क्योंकि दानशीलता और उदारता को मुसलमानों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण गुण माना जाता है

in_pashto.name: جواده
in_pashto.long_meaning: جواده د عربی نوم دی چې د جواد څخه اخیستل شوی، چې د بakhشۍ او ډېرې مېنه والي په معنی دی، دا نوم په افغان او پښتنو کې ډېر مهم دی، ځکه چې بakhشۍ او ډېرې مېنه والی د مسلمانانو لپاره ډېر مهم دي

in_english.name: Jawaadah
in_english.long_meaning: Jawaadah is an Arabic name derived from Jawad, meaning generosity and charity, this name is very important in Islamic culture, as generosity and charity are considered key virtues for Muslims, and are emphasized in the Quran

pronunciation.urdu: جوادہ کا تلفظ جوا دہ ہے

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Jawaadah is known to represent the ideal of being kind, benevolent, and charitable towards others. It embodies the spirit of giving and serving, and being well-versed in knowledge and wisdom. Jawaadah is also a name associated with nobility, respect, and high social standing.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, the name Jawaadah holds spiritual significance as being a reminder of the importance of generosity and kindness towards others. It emphasizes the notion of practicing selflessness and giving in abundance, as acts of worship that please Allah (God). The name Jawaadah symbolizes the spiritual journey of constantly striving to increase in good deeds and charitable acts. It also represents a dedication to upholding the moral values and principles of Islam, and being a good example to others. Ultimately, the name Jawaadah encourages one to strive for inner contentment and peace, by focusing on serving others and pleasing Allah.
